# BuildResponse

The result of a build: whether it succeeded, its log, and each definition it created, updated or left unchanged. The definition lists are empty when the build failed.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `isSuccess` | `boolean` | Whether the build succeeded: its log has no `Error` entry. Set by Maitento. |
| `isDeployed` | `boolean` | Whether the definitions were deployed. Always false for a validation. |
| `buildId` | `uuid \| null` | The build's id. Read its record with `GET /builds/by-id/{id}`. Null when the build could not be recorded. |
| `log` | [`CompilationLogEntry`](compilation-log-entry.md)`[]` | The build's messages, in order: errors, warnings and information, each with where it came from. |
| `agents` | [`BuildEntityOfAgent`](build-entity-of-agent.md)`[]` | The agents in the build. |
| `capsules` | [`BuildEntityOfCapsule`](build-entity-of-capsule.md)`[]` | The capsules in the build. |
| `connectors` | [`BuildConnectorsResponse`](build-connectors-response.md) | The connectors in the build. |
| `externalOperations` | [`BuildExternalOperationsResponse`](build-external-operations-response.md) | The tools in the build. |
| `interactions` | [`BuildInteractionsResponse`](build-interactions-response.md) | The interactions in the build. |
| `apps` | [`BuildEntityOfApp`](build-entity-of-app.md)`[]` | The apps in the build. |
| `codePipelines` | [`BuildEntityOfCodePipeline`](build-entity-of-code-pipeline.md)`[]` | The code pipelines in the build. |
| `looms` | [`BuildEntityOfLoom`](build-entity-of-loom.md)`[]` | The named looms in the build. |
